title: SSR-Safe Theme Switching & Eradicating Theme Flash (FOUC)
subtopicTitle: SSR-Safe Theme Switching & Eradicating Theme Flash (FOUC)
problemStatement:
Preventing the dreaded white flash when a user with Dark Mode enabled loads an SSR/Next.js/Remix web application.

**Enterprise Importance**:
Theme flashing (FOUC) creates a jarring, unpolished experience and is an immediate red flag in senior frontend technical interviews.
interviewTrap: Using a `useEffect` hook to set the dark theme classname, which executes *after* the initial server-rendered HTML has already painted.

solutionCode:

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Execute a tiny, synchronous blocking inline script in the `<head>` before any HTML renders to read `localStorage` or `matchMedia` and apply the `data-theme` attribute to `<html>`.
